about: US library pages (owner decisions, 23 November 2026), built by tools/seo/build-pages.mjs with tools/seo/check-pages.mjs. Every US library of a catalog family with pages (BiblioCommons; TLC from 24 November 2026: tools/seo/check-pages.mjs PAGE_PLATFORMS) offered when finding a library (server/data/us-catalogs-listed.json lists it, as legacy, verified or connected, and its removed list does not) has a page at /libraries/<slug>, except the entries in leftOut, with the directory's facts (the city from shared/seo-us-cities.json where the IMLS survey gives the system's own city) and the first ten books of shared/us-book-pool.json to check live, on a reader's tap. Nothing is checked in advance: BiblioCommons' terms forbid automated collection and TLC's are unread, so neither's availability is stored (server/data/catalog-policies.json). libraries is generated, never typed: run node tools/seo/us-pages.mjs after the listed file or leftOut changes (a test fails until it is current). A slug, once given, is kept: it is the library's /select/ link name when the page is added (the four California guides keep their guide slug; a hash suffix is dropped). state is the directory's state; on is the date the page was added or its state changed. leftOut is kept by hand: an entry that is not one public library system (a school, a college, a kids' catalog, a consortium's shared catalog whose member libraries have their own pages; sameCatalogAs names a page with the same location list) or a catalog the app can no longer read, with the reason and date. firstStates: the states /libraries shows first; the others follow alphabetically.

leftOut.reason: Cooperative Computer Services is the shared catalog of a consortium of north-suburban Illinois libraries, not one library system: the IMLS survey matches its location list to 32 member libraries, and 31 of them have their own entries and pages. 26 of those show the same 56 locations, Algonquin Area Public Library among them.

Lakeland Library Cooperative is the shared catalog of a cooperative of west Michigan libraries, not one library system: the IMLS survey matches its location list to 40 member libraries, and 39 of them have their own entries and pages. Carson City Public Library and White Cloud Community Library show the same 57 locations.

Local Public Library Partnership is the shared catalog of two libraries, Muskegon Area District Library and White Lake Community Library (IMLS survey), each with its own entry and page; Muskegon Area District Library shows the same 15 locations.
MARINet is the shared catalog of the Marin County library consortium, with college and university libraries among its members; Marin County Free Library has its own entry with the same 23 locations.
Dr. MLK Academy is a school library, not a public library system.
Nicasio School is a school library, not a public library system.
Napa Valley College is a college library, not a public library system.

PAC2 is the shared catalog of northern Michigan libraries, not one library system: the IMLS survey matches its location list to 9 member libraries, all with their own entries and pages. Ten pages show the same 27 locations, Alcona County Library among them.
BiblioCommons site disabled; library moved to Vega Discover (checked 23 Nov 2026)
Solano Community College is a college library, not a public library system.
St. Helena Public Library left BiblioCommons for the SPLASH consortium's Polaris and Vega catalog in 2022; removed from finding a library (server/data/us-catalogs-listed.json).
